public_observations.text: SciToolAgent-Evo declares experience applicability s_e, but its formal retrieval equation selects general plus domain-specific TopK experiences by q and does not expose an explicit s_e compatibility filter. No exact Evo implementation revision was discovered in the checked public GitHub surfaces, so operational enforcement remains unresolved rather than disproved.

RSMeM FAM is hard-scoped to the exact instance/question ID: Latest(M_i) and get_latest_reflection(question_id) reuse only that target's most recent failure reflection, deliberately avoiding unrelated failure-pattern interference.

RSMeM FAR-only provides direct science-domain component evidence for failure-memory retries: Qwen3-8B outcome accuracy 31.98 to 39.68 and DeepSeek-V3.2 48.18 to 53.44. It is same-target retry evidence, not cross-target applicability revalidation.

RSMeM summary_ftro separates bounded operational reflection memory from provenance sidecars: request/reflection artifacts bind question ID, full-trajectory SHA-256, FTRO SHA-256, and prompt SHA-256; cached reuse requires matching trajectory hashes.

SAGE's deterministic reporting gate grounds numeric result values and condition names, yet the paper documents method-provenance failures where prose names datasets/libraries/models/tests not used by executed code. Numeric grounding is therefore not complete scientific-claim grounding.

protocol_inferences.name: DECLARED_APPLICABILITY_IS_NOT_ENFORCEMENT
protocol_inferences.text: Do not treat an applicability field as an enforcement gate unless explicit inspectable runtime logic consumes it before adoption/action.

protocol_inferences.name: EXACT_SCOPE_KEY_FOR_RETRY_MEMORY
protocol_inferences.text: Same-instance failure memory can use exact target identity as the applicability boundary; cross-target reuse needs separate requalification.

protocol_inferences.name: BOUNDED_OPERATIONAL_MEMORY_WITH_PROVENANCE_SIDECAR
protocol_inferences.text: Keep retry/handoff context compact while binding it to immutable sidecar evidence for source trace, prompt, and relevant artifact digests.

protocol_inferences.name: METHOD_CLAIM_PROVENANCE_COVERAGE
protocol_inferences.text: A completion verifier must cover methodological prose against executed code/config/dataset artifacts, not merely ground numeric outputs.
